## Background on auditor choice

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
size_big4 = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
        pl.col("sale") > 0,
        pl.col("at") > 0,
        pl.col("fyear") == 2019,
        pl.col("au").is_not_null()
    )
    .with_columns(
        au=pl.col("au").cast(pl.Int32),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho") * 1e6,
    )
    .with_columns(big4=pl.col("au").is_between(1, 8))
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "au", "big4", "mkt_cap")
    .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
)
```

## Simulation analysis

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
prob_big4 = (
    size_big4
    .filter(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 1e6)
    .select("big4", "mkt_cap")
    .with_columns(pl.col("mkt_cap").log10().name.prefix("log_"))
    .with_columns(
        bin=pl.col("log_mkt_cap").cut(
            np.arange(6.0, 12.25 + 0.25, 0.25),
            left_closed=False,
        )
    )
    .with_columns(
        p_big4=pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Float64).mean().over("bin")
    )
    .select("mkt_cap", "log_mkt_cap", "p_big4")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
n_firms = 5000
rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)

sim_auditor = (
    prob_big4
    .collect()
    .sample(n=n_firms, with_replacement=False, seed=2021)
    .with_row_index("id", offset=1)
    .with_columns(
        pl.Series("rand", rng.random(n_firms)),
        pl.Series("epsilon", rng.standard_normal(n_firms)),
    )
    .with_columns(
        big4=(pl.col("rand") < pl.col("p_big4")),
        audit_quality=(
            (pl.col("mkt_cap") ** (1 / 3)) * 0.003
            + pl.col("epsilon")
        ),
    )
    .select("id", "big4", "mkt_cap", "log_mkt_cap", "audit_quality")
)
```

The causal diagram for this simulation is $Z \rightarrow X$, $Z \rightarrow Y$, where $Z$ is market capitalization, $X$ is having a Big Four auditor, and the true coefficient on $X \rightarrow Y$ is zero (shown as a dashed arrow in the book).

```{python}
#| include: false
fm = sp.feols(
    "audit_quality ~ big4 + I(mkt_cap / 1e9)",
    data=sim_auditor,
    vcov="iid",
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| warning: false
sim_ps_data = sim_auditor.with_columns(
    treat=(~pl.col("big4")).cast(pl.Int8)
)

sim_fm = sp.glm(
    "treat ~ mkt_cap",
    data=sim_ps_data,
    family="binomial",
    link="logit",
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
sim_match_pscores = sim_ps_data.with_columns(
    pl.Series("pscore", sim_fm.fitted_values())
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| warning: false
sim_match = sp.match(
    sim_match_pscores, y="audit_quality", treat="treat",
    covariates=["mkt_cap"], pscore="pscore",
    replace=False, n_matches=1, caliper=0.03, m_order="largest",
)
sim_matches = (
    pl.from_pandas(sim_match.matched_data)
    .filter(pl.col("_weight") > 0)
    .with_columns(subclass=pl.coalesce("_n1", "_id").cast(pl.Int64))
    .select(*sim_match_pscores.columns, "subclass")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
fms_sim = {
    "MR": sp.feols("audit_quality ~ big4", data=sim_matches, vcov="iid"),
    "MR + controls": sp.feols(
        "audit_quality ~ big4 + I(mkt_cap / 1e9)",
        data=sim_matches,
        vcov="iid",
    ),
}
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: tbl-lin-reg

sp.regtable(

    se_type="t",
    digits=3,
    star_levels=(0.10, 0.05, 0.01),
    stats=["N", "R2"],

)
```

## Replication of @Lawrence:2011tv

```{python}
#| include: false
comp = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
    )
    .select(
        "gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "au", "prcc_f",
        "csho", "at", "ib", "dltt", "dlc", "rect", "ppent",
        "sale", "act", "lct", "sich", "oancf", "ceq",
    )
    .filter(pl.col("fyear").is_between(1986, 2006))
    .sort("gvkey", "fyear")
    .with_columns(sic2=pl.col("sich").floordiv(100))
    .with_columns(curr=pl.col("act").era.div_if_pos("lct"))
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("fyear", "at", "sale", "rect", "curr")
        .shift(1)
        .over("gvkey")
        .name.prefix("lag_")
    )
    .with_columns(
        avg_at=(pl.col("lag_at") + pl.col("at")) / 2,
        d_sale=pl.col("sale") - pl.col("lag_sale"),
        d_rect=pl.col("rect") - pl.col("lag_rect"),
        accruals=pl.col("ib") - pl.col("oancf"),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        log_at=pl.col("at").log(),
        aturn=pl.col("sale").era.div_if_pos("lag_at"),
        inv_avg_at=(
            pl.when(pl.col("avg_at") != 0)
            .then(1 / pl.col("avg_at"))
            .otherwise(None)
        ),
        d_sale_at=(
            (pl.col("d_sale") - pl.col("d_rect"))
            .era.div_if_pos("avg_at")
        ),
        ppe_at=(
            pl.col("ppent").era.div_if_pos("avg_at")
        ),
        lev=(pl.col("dltt") + pl.col("dlc").fill_null(0))
            .era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        roa=pl.col("ib").era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        ta=pl.col("accruals").era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        log_mkt=(
            pl.when(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("mkt_cap").log())
        ),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("lev", "roa")
        .shift(1)
        .over("gvkey")
        .name.prefix("lag_")
    )
    .filter(
        pl.col("sich").is_not_null(),
        ~pl.col("sich").is_between(6000, 6999),
        pl.col("sale") > 0,
        pl.col("at") > 0,
        (pl.col("dltt") >= 0) | pl.col("dltt").is_null(),
        (pl.col("dlc") >= 0) | pl.col("dlc").is_null(),
        pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho") > 0,
        pl.col("ceq") > 0,
        pl.col("fyear").is_between(1988, 2006),
        pl.col("au").cast(pl.Int32, strict=False).is_not_null(),
    )
    .filter(pl.col("lag_fyear") == (pl.col("fyear") - 1))
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
industries = (
    comp
    .group_by("fyear", "sic2")
    .agg(n_firms=pl.len())
    .filter(pl.col("n_firms") >= 10)
    .select("fyear", "sic2")
    .collect()
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
def get_klw_data(sic2: int, fyear: int) -> pl.DataFrame:
    reg_data = (
        comp
        .filter(pl.col("sic2") == sic2,
                pl.col("fyear") == fyear)
        .select(
            "gvkey", "fyear", "roa", "ta",
            "inv_avg_at", "d_sale_at", "ppe_at"
        )
        .filter(
            pl.all_horizontal(
                pl.col("roa", "ta", "inv_avg_at", "d_sale_at", "ppe_at")
                .is_finite()
            )
        )
        .collect()
    )

    if reg_data.height < 10:
        return reg_data.select("gvkey", "fyear").head(0).with_columns(
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("da"),
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("ada"),
        )

    x = np.column_stack(
        [
            np.ones(reg_data.height),
            reg_data["inv_avg_at"],
            reg_data["d_sale_at"],
            reg_data["ppe_at"],
        ]
    )
    y = reg_data["ta"]
    try:
        beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(x, y, rcond=None)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return reg_data.select("gvkey", "fyear").head(0).with_columns(
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("da"),
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("ada"),
        )

    results = (
        reg_data
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "roa").with_columns(
            da=pl.Series(name="da", values=(y - x @ beta))
        )
    )

    pairs = (
        results
        .join(
            results.rename(
                {
                    "gvkey": "gvkey_match",
                    "roa": "roa_match",
                    "da": "da_match",
                }
            ),
            on="fyear",
            how="inner",
        )
        .filter(pl.col("gvkey") != pl.col("gvkey_match"))
    )
    if pairs.height == 0:
        return reg_data.select("gvkey", "fyear").head(0).with_columns(
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("da"),
            pl.lit(None, dtype=pl.Float64).alias("ada"),
        )

    return (
        pairs
        .with_columns(
            roa_diff=(pl.col("roa") - pl.col("roa_match")).abs()
        )
        .sort("gvkey", "fyear", "roa_diff", "gvkey_match")
        .group_by("gvkey", "fyear")
        .first()
        .with_columns(
            ada=(pl.col("da") - pl.col("da_match")).abs()
        )
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "da", "ada")
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
klw_results = pl.concat(
    [
        get_klw_data(**row)
        for row in industries.iter_rows(named=True)
    ],
    how="vertical",
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
full_sample = (
    comp
    .collect()
    .join(klw_results, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("avg_at") > 0)
    .with_columns(
        big4=pl.col("au").cast(pl.Int32).is_between(1, 8),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho"),
        log_mkt=(
            pl.when(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("mkt_cap").log())
        ),
    )
)

formula_klw = (
    "ada ~ big4 + log_mkt + lag_roa + lag_lev + lag_curr "
    "| sic2 + fyear"
)

fms = {
    "OLS": sp.feols(
        formula_klw,
        data=full_sample.with_columns(pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8)),
        vcov={"CRV1": "gvkey"},
    )
}
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
win_vars = [
    "ada", "log_mkt", "lag_roa", "lag_lev", "lag_curr",
    "roa", "lev", "curr", "mkt_cap"
]

full_sample_win = (
    full_sample
    .with_columns(pl.col(win_vars).era.winsorize(),
                  pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8))
)

fms["OLS, win"] = sp.feols(formula_klw, data=full_sample_win, vcov={"CRV1": "gvkey"})
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
def psm_match(df: pl.DataFrame, caliper: float = 0.03) -> pl.DataFrame:
    match_covars = ["log_at", "log_mkt", "aturn", "curr", "lev", "roa"]
    reg_vars = ["ada", "big4", "log_mkt", "lag_roa",
                "lag_lev", "lag_curr", "sic2", "fyear"]

    covars = match_covars + reg_vars

    d = (
        df
        .filter(pl.all_horizontal(pl.col(covars).is_not_null()))
        .with_columns(
            big4=pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8),
            treat=(pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8) == 0).cast(pl.Int8),
        )
    )

    ps_fm = sp.glm(
        "treat ~ log_at + log_mkt + aturn + curr + lev + roa",
        data=d.select("treat", *match_covars),
        family="binomial",
        link="logit",
        tol=1e-12,
    )

    d = d.with_columns(
        pscore=pl.Series("pscore", ps_fm.fitted_values())
    )

    treatment = d["treat"].to_numpy()
    rng = np.random.RandomState(2021)
    treated = rng.permutation(np.flatnonzero(treatment == 1))
    controls = np.flatnonzero(treatment == 0)

    match_data = d.select("ada", "treat", "pscore", *match_covars).with_row_index("match_row")
    match = sp.match(
        match_data[np.concatenate((treated, controls))],
        y="ada", treat="treat", covariates=match_covars, pscore="pscore",
        replace=False, n_matches=1, caliper=caliper, m_order="data",
    )
    matched_rows = (
        pl.from_pandas(match.matched_data)
        .filter(pl.col("_weight") > 0)
        .get_column("match_row")
    )
    return d[matched_rows]

lmz_matched = psm_match(full_sample, caliper=0.03)
fms["PSM"] = sp.feols(formula_klw, data=lmz_matched, vcov={"CRV1": "gvkey"})
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
lmz_matched_win = psm_match(full_sample_win, caliper=0.03)
fms["PSM, win"] = sp.feols(formula_klw, data=lmz_matched_win, vcov={"CRV1": "gvkey"})
```
